name: agent-review-10-none-of-the-above
goal: An answer that is supposed to stand alone on a tick-box question, which the product cannot enforce.

messages.text: I want a one page survey for the council, called Marchfield Council contact survey. Ask how they got in touch with us and let them tick every way they used: by phone, by email, through the website, in person. Then a last answer for people who did not contact us at all. Anyone picking that last one must not be able to tick the others as well.

seed.requires: A dev database with no form titled Marchfield Council contact survey.
seed.fixtures: All data is invented: Marchfield Council is not a real council and no scenario sends a real person's details.

assistantMust: say, without being asked, that an answer which cannot be ticked alongside the others is not something the form can hold
say that the form will accept the last answer together with the others and that nothing flags it
add the last answer as the final choice anyway, in the council's own words, and put the rule into the guidance line under the question
offer splitting it into two questions as the way to get the rule, rather than leaving the limit as the whole answer
put the question and the form on one plan, and publish nothing

notes: The defect this came from is a form built with the standalone answer silently tickable alongside the others, and nothing said about it. Capping the number of answers at one is the wrong fix and a failure: it forbids two ordinary answers as well. Saying the limit and offering the two-question shape is the pass.
